overview_description.description: Ajaib is a financial super app that allows Indonesians to buy and sell stocks, ETFs, and mutual funds. The company is committed to opening the door to access investment instruments that are safe, trusted, and affordable. Its stock and mutual fund services can be accessed online, by all walks of life. The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Jakarta,  Indonesia.
